title: fix(plugin-approvals,plugin-sharing): the approver a pending step waits on reads the record its request is about
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQ8cRQ3qrqydKXXbAgwLfCm)_

Fixes #26180

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:审批请求处于待审时,当前步骤审批人名单上的人(按用户 id 或账号邮箱)和覆盖权持有人,可以只读打开该请求对应的那一条记录;步骤一结束就收回。
- 为什么改:审批人此前常常打不开要审的记录,只能看快照就批合同;这次按裁决 A 从名单推导读权,不新增任何元数据键或应用声明。
- 风险与回滚:新增的是一条只读的行级读权,写入口径不读它;查不到或审批服务缺席时一律不授(fail-closed),也不跨组织。回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据迁移。
- 先看:`plugin-approvals/src/pending-approver-read-grant.ts`(谁有读权、组织围栏、按请求缓存)、`plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.ts` 的 `buildReadFilter` 并入处与 fail-closed 分支、`plugin-security/src/explain-engine.ts` 的 approval request 归因。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run test/approval-pending-approver-record-read.dogfood.test.ts`,预期 1 passed:审批人 200、陌生人 404、PATCH 403、批准/驳回后 404。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

While an approval request is pending, each **person** on its current step's slate and the **override holder** may **read** the one record the request is about. The grant is derived from state plugin-approvals already keeps (the pending-approver index `sys_approval_approver`), so nothing is declared: no metadata key, no app setting (ruling 6429330267, letter A).

- **`@objectstack/plugin-approvals`**: new `PendingApproverReadGrantSource` (`pending-approver-read-grant.ts`), exposed as `ApprovalService.pendingApproverReadGrants(object, context)`, which answers `record id → pending request ids`.
  - A person is a slot naming the caller's user id or the email their own account carries, taken from `actingAddresses` with no positions (the two addresses `slateNamesAPerson` calls a person). A `position:`/`team:` literal names no person and grants nothing.
  - The override holder is `isOverrideActor` asked with the caller's active organization: every pending request of that organization.
  - Both probes are fenced to the caller's active organization (an org-less caller reaches org-less requests only). The platform admin's override crosses the wall to decide, not to read.
  - The request row is re-read with `status: 'pending'`, and the index only holds rows while pending, so a step that is approved, rejected or advanced stops granting at the next read.
  - Cost: memoized per execution context and per engine write epoch (the `permissionSetMemo` precedent). A person's first read is one `sys_user` read and one indexed `sys_approval_approver` read; a caller on no slate stops there for every object. A caller on a slate, or the override holder, pays one `sys_approval_request` read per object. Never a read per row. Only settled answers are memoized; a failed read rejects and is asked again next time.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-sharing`**: `SharingService.buildReadFilter` ORs those record ids into the `id $in` arm beside the caller's record shares, so every read door composing the sharing filter serves them. The probe is late-bound to the `approvals` service and fails closed: no approvals service, no member, a lookup or read that throws, or an on-behalf-of principal (ADR-0090 D10) all grant nothing, with one warn line when a read fails. Write gates read `sys_record_share` access levels only, so the member cannot write. New `listApprovalReadGrants(object, recordId, context)` for explain.
- **`@objectstack/plugin-security`**: `explain` attributes the grant on the sharing layer as a `record_share` rule with `via: "approval request N"`: `admits` on read, `neutral` on writes. A failing lookup attributes nothing.
- Attachments: no new child reach. ADR-0104's parent-read inheritance follows the record read as for any reader. #8652 is untouched.

## Tests

- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/approval-pending-approver-record-read.dogfood.test.ts` (new, real `bootStack`, red first on main): a private object, a two-step flow with approvers by email. The first approver gets GET 200 and the record in the list; a stranger gets 404; the approver's PATCH is 403 with nothing landed; `POST /security/explain` names "approval request N"; the override holder (`organization_admin_no_bypass`) reads; approving advances the step (first approver 404, second approver 200); the final approval revokes (second approver and overrider 404); a rejection revokes.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-approvals/src/pending-approver-read-grant.integration.test.ts` (new, ObjectQL + SqlDriver on better-sqlite3): person by id and by email, position literal grants nobody, stranger/submitter get nothing; override holder; decided requests (approve, reject) grant nothing, also on the same context; the org wall holds, for the platform admin and for an org-less caller too; the cost pin (five reads of one object plus one of another = `sys_user`, `sys_approval_approver`, two `sys_approval_request` reads; a stranger costs two reads; a write retires the memo); a rejected read is rethrown and not memoized.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/sharing-service.test.ts`: seven cases on the OR-in, the join with record shares, no write gate, not asked for null/deny, delegated principal gets none, the fail-closed variants, and `listApprovalReadGrants`.
- `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.test.ts`: attribution on read (admits) and update (neutral), and a failing lookup attributes nothing.
- `approver-address-readers.test.ts`: the new slot comparison site is classified as a reader.

## Acceptance notes

- The approval grant is the row-level reach of a read share: the approver still needs read on the object itself, as for any record share.
- A unanimous or quorum voter leaves the slate once they vote (the index drops their row), so they lose the read while the step stays pending for the others. That follows "each resolved person on the current step's slate".
- Explain reuses kind `record_share` with `via: "approval request N"`, because a dedicated kind is a spec enum edit plus a ui label, outside this card.
- The org-wall test lives at the service level: the dogfood boot is single-organization.
- Overlap: #26337 (ownership queues) edits the same insertion points in `sharing-service.ts` (options, field, constructor, the `buildReadFilter` tail), `sharing-plugin.ts` and `explain-engine.ts`. `git merge-tree` reports content conflicts in those three files, all adjacent inserts. Whichever lands second keeps both: the queue disjunct and the approval ids in the `id $in` arm. No other open PR touches these files.
- Dogfood Regression Gate does not run on PRs; the dogfood file above was run locally on the final head.
